blocks.title: Class NP
blocks.text: Class NP (Non-deterministic Polynomial time) un masail ka majmooa hai jin ka pesh kiya gaya hal computer jaldi jaanch sakta hai, agarche hal dhoondna mushkil aur waqt talab ho sakta hai.

Misal: Sudoku. 9 x 9 grid aise bhara jata hai ke har qataar, sutoon aur 3 x 3 chhoti grid mein 1 se 9 tak har hindsa theek ek baar ho. Mukammal grid jaanchna aasan hai: har qataar, sutoon aur chhoti grid mein dohrao dekhein. Shuru se puzzle hal karne mein bohat aazmaish o khata ya advanced algorithm lag sakta hai, aur koi saada tez tareeqa nahi jo hamesha chale.

items: NP: diya gaya hal jaldi jaancha ja sakta hai; dhoondna mushkil ho sakta hai (Sudoku).
